subject: Subscription cadence realignment & scale runway proposal
body:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire@evosolve.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Subscription cadence realignment & scale runway proposal

Hi Claire,

Following our QBR last week, thanks again for sharing EvoSolve's FY26 forecast. Based on the usage shape you sent, we've put together a proposal that prioritizes predictability for EvoSolve while keeping you positioned to scale quickly when needed. High level:

- 36-month term with a frontloaded burst bucket for Q1–Q3 FY26 to cover the pilot spikes; quarterly true-ups (30 days post-quarter) to reconcile actual usage.
- Annualized credit overlay that reduces per-token price after each annual milestone if growth thresholds are met.
- Optional auto-scale runway: if average utilization exceeds 80% for a 30-day window, additional dedicated capacity is provisioned on a pre-negotiated incremental price band (you can opt out).
- Co-terming: we propose bringing all product lines onto the same Jan anniversary to simplify billing and support.

Attached is a sketch of the amendment language and an initial SOW for the planned scale testing. We left an early-exit clause tied to a mutual transition window (60 days) to reduce vendor lock concerns.

Would you be open to a short call early next week to walk through the amendment and the burst/capacity mechanics? If yes, I can share a redline and a DocuSign-ready version.

Thanks,

—
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-scaling-plan.xlsx (draft)

-----
On Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:30:22 -0800, Claire Park <claire@evosolve.com> wrote:

> From: Claire Park <claire@evosolve.com>
> To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
> Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:30:22 -0800
> Subject: Re: Subscription cadence realignment & scale runway proposal>
>
> Michael,
>
> Thanks for the outline — this looks promising. A couple of clarifying Qs from our side before we escalate to procurement: 
>
> 1) For the frontloaded burst bucket, can you quantify how credits are consumed when dedicated capacity is provisioned (i.e., is burst billed as consumption-first or as a reserved block)?
> 2) The auto-scale runway: what is the lead time to provision additional dedicated nodes, and is there a hard cap we should expect?
> 3) We prefer a single annual invoice if possible; quarterly true-ups are fine but need to land on one invoice per year for our AR process.
>
> I've attached our usage forecast (Q1–Q4 FY26) so you can validate the thresholds.
>
> Claire Park
> Head of Platform Ops, EvoSolve
> claire@evosolve.com | 650-555-0124
> Attachment: EvoSolve_usage_QL.xlsx

On Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:04:18 +0000, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:

> From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
> To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
> Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:04:18 +0000
> Subject: Fwd: Subscription cadence realignment & scale runway proposal (Claire questions)
>
> Michael — forwarding Claire's note and the usage file. Quick suggestions before we reply to EvoSolve: 
>
> - Burst mechanics: recommend we present burst as a reserved block credited against consumption; when dedicated capacity is active, consumption is deducted from the reserved block first, then falls back to consumption rates. This simplifies forecasting for their AR.
> - Lead time: ops can do a soft-provision (logical reservation) within 24 hours, physical capacity (GPU pool assignment) within 5 business days. We should call out the soft-provision guarantee in the amendment.
> - Invoice cadence: we can offer annual invoicing with quarterly true-ups applied as credit/debit notes, delivered in the annual invoice package. That aligns with their ask.
>
> Karthik — can you draft the pricing ladder showing: baseline token rate, burst-reserved-block rate, and incremental dedicated-capacity band? Also include an SLA credit for provisioning misses (e.g., if physical capacity not available within 7 business days, EvoSolve gets a 10% credit on the affected quarter).
>
> Marissa — FYI for legal on the proposed 60-day mutual transition window and the auto-scale opt-out language.
>
> Thanks,
> Camila
>
> -----
> On Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:18:02 +0000, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
>
> > From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

> > Subject: Re: Fwd: Subscription cadence realignment & scale runway proposal (Claire questions)
> >
> > Thanks Camila. Drafting pricing ladder now — will include three bands: baseline (usage), burst-reserved block (30% discount vs baseline), and dedicated-incremental (45% discount for committed add-on).
> >
> > I'll include a provision for re-pricing if year-over-year growth >200% in any 90-day window (safeguard for extreme spikes). Also proposing a one-time onboarding credit to offset initial scale testing (applied against Q1 true-up).
> >
> > I'll circulate the redline by EoD Friday.
> >
> > - Karthik
> >
>

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire@evosolve.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Final draft: amendment + SOW for scale runway (DocuSign link)

Claire —

Thanks for the quick feedback and for the usage file. Per our internal alignment we've attached: 1) Enterprise_AMENDMENT_v2.pdf (redline + clean), and 2) SOW-scaling-plan.xlsx (detailed milestones and acceptance criteria). Key updates from the draft: 

- Burst is a reserved credit block consumed first; any overage is billed at baseline usage rates.
- Soft-provision is guaranteed in 24 hours; physical capacity fallback in 5 business days with SLA credits if missed (see Section 4.2).
- Invoice cadence: one annual invoice with quarterly true-up notes; AR will receive a single invoice per contract year.
- Auto-scale runway: opt-in configurable per environment; we added explicit opt-out language for regulated workloads.

If this looks good, sign here: https://docusign.net/secure/12345 — I've set the execution routing to EvoSolve (Claire) → EvoSolve Legal → Redwood Legal.

Can we aim to have this fully executed by Feb 5 so onboarding can begin mid-February?

Best,

—
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0192

Attachments: Enterprise_AMENDMENT_v2.pdf, SOW-scaling-plan.xlsx
